resisted: Chain 1701->2480 (+0.89 logit when a2!=1 and a5!=4) has no clear role: flips 2 train predictions and removing it slightly raises accuracy; explained as a near-vestigial nudge.
rule_agreement: 'Exactly two of six' with a5 mishandled: a5=1 is a veto rather than an indicator, so all 20 train positives with a5=1 plus one other indicator are missed; approximate rule agrees with the model on 418/432 configurations.
summary: sigmoid(1.855 + Ramp - 7.41 Gate + 0.618 Chain): Ramp adds 3.6-10.5 logit per first value of a1,a2,a3,a4,a6 and ~-8 for a5=1; Gate fires iff >=3 of {a1,a2,a3,a4,a6}=1. Predicts positive roughly iff exactly two of those five AND a5!=1. Train acc 0.901, AUC 0.915.
